svg.title: Exact-Match Domain Acquisition Gates
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-emd-acquisition-gates; chapter number: 5; title: Exact-Match Domain Acquisition Gates; subtitle: Volume, intent, footprint and deal readiness before the bid; chart type: decision_tree; nodes: gate: G1; question: Does the exact phrase draw more than 1,000 exact-match searches per month?; pass next: G2; fail action: Drop traffic-based valuation and price through buyer type, equity and industry trend phase (Chris Zuiker).; gate: G2; question: Do the live Google results confirm the right booking or research intent?; pass next: G3; fail action: Put the money toward building a better website instead (Launch with Bryan).; gate: G3; question: Is the name a standalone asset rather than part of a same-day EMD batch?; pass next: G4; fail action: Abort the batch; 22 sites with 19 registered within 35 seconds reads as doorway abuse (LLMrefs AI SEO).; gate: G4; question: Are financing and a fill-in-the-number contract ready before the approach?; pass next: Acquire, expecting any buy above $100K to get shopped around; fail action: Stage funds, paperwork and a broker first, or bridge the gap with an option-plus-lease carrying a $25-50K deposit on a $500K name (Rosener).; caption: Rosener values generic .coms from exact-match volume above 1,000 monthly searches and an 85% top-organic click share; Gargiulo paid $1M for vpn.com after nearly 4 years.; assumptions note: Gate order is an organizing sequence across Q5 practitioners; whether EMDs still carry SEO benefit is disputed, with PPC Better saying none since 2012.; note: Sources domainsherpa with Andrew Rosener (HfWOYwPZ1HU @ 00:11:38), Launch with Bryan (ASaM7hIMKVI @ 00:03:28), LLMrefs AI SEO (XEh3aA3iqtI @ 00:00:55), VPN.com (nwlWrMSMdUU @ 00:01:14), domainsherpa with Michael Gargiulo (J6_UP-VNOco @ 00:31:50).

circle.title: gate: G1; question: Does the exact phrase draw more than 1,000 exact-match searches per month?; pass next: G2; fail action: Drop traffic-based valuation and price through buyer type, equity and industry trend phase (Chris Zuiker).
gate: G2; question: Do the live Google results confirm the right booking or research intent?; pass next: G3; fail action: Put the money toward building a better website instead (Launch with Bryan).

gate: G3; question: Is the name a standalone asset rather than part of a same-day EMD batch?; pass next: G4; fail action: Abort the batch; 22 sites with 19 registered within 35 seconds reads as doorway abuse (LLMrefs AI SEO).

gate: G4; question: Are financing and a fill-in-the-number contract ready before the approach?; pass next: Acquire, expecting any buy above $100K to get shopped around; fail action: Stage funds, paperwork and a broker first, or bridge the gap with an option-plus-lease carrying a $25-50K deposit on a $500K name (Rosener).

text.title: Assumptions: Gate order is an organizing sequence across Q5 practitioners; whether EMDs still carry SEO benefit is disputed, with PPC Better saying none since 2012.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Gate order is an organizing sequence across Q5 practitioners; whether EMDs still carry SEO benefit is disputed, with PPC
